drafter.private_reasoning: Strengthen the mutual NDA with standard use, access, and disclosure exceptions while preserving the draft’s three-year protection period and twenty-four-month term. Do not disclose the client’s confidential information.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Attached are proposed mutual NDA edits clarifying permitted use, standard confidentiality exceptions, and how the protection period applies after the agreement ends. We have kept the proposed three-year protection period and twenty-four-month term.

edits.text: 1. PURPOSE AND USE. The parties may exchange confidential information to evaluate a potential transaction (the “Purpose”). Each receiving party shall use the other party’s confidential information solely for the Purpose and may disclose it only to its representatives who need to know it for that Purpose and are bound by confidentiality obligations or professional duties of confidentiality. The receiving party is responsible for its representatives’ compliance with this Agreement.
edits.name: Purpose and permitted use

edits.text: 2. CONFIDENTIALITY. Each receiving party shall protect the disclosing party’s confidential information with reasonable care, and no less than the care it uses for its own comparable information, for three years from disclosure. Confidential information does not include information the receiving party can demonstrate was publicly available without breach of this Agreement, already known to it without a duty of confidentiality, lawfully received from another source without such a duty, or independently developed without use of the disclosed information. If disclosure is required by law, the receiving party may disclose only what is required and, where legally permitted, shall give prompt notice and reasonable cooperation in seeking protection.
edits.name: Protection and exceptions

edits.text: 3. TERM. This Agreement remains in effect for twenty-four months from signing. Its expiration does not shorten the three-year protection period applicable to information disclosed while it was in effect. Neither party is obligated to disclose information or proceed with a transaction.
edits.name: Term and survival
